states.label: AcknowledgeIssue
states.expectedResult: I understand the issue and I will help you with it.
states.receiverDialogue: Thank you. I need help resolving this.

states.label: ClarifyDetails
states.expectedResult: Could you share when the issue started and what you observed?
states.receiverDialogue: It started today when I tried to continue my work.

states.label: OfferResolution
states.expectedResult: I can guide you through the next steps to resolve this.
states.receiverDialogue: Yes, please guide me through the steps.

states.label: ConfirmResolution
states.expectedResult: Can you confirm that the issue is now resolved?
states.receiverDialogue: Yes, it is working now. Thank you.
